summary: Frontend-only verification of Customer Stock Dashboard layout fix at 1450px, 1920px, and 390px. All acceptance criteria met: header on single row with h1 and Excel button (top diff 9px) at both desktop widths, next-order dates render as 'DD Mon' two-token format with no year and no 'Sept' (e.g. '15 Oct', '25 Sep', '22 Sep', '29 Sep'), zero truncation across all 8 tiles (scrollWidth == clientWidth), critical tiles (Seed A/C/G/H) display shortfall in rose before In hand value (-12/8cr, -2/3cr, -4/10cr, -5/0cr), footer 'Last order 20 cr · 14 Sep' has no year, mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow (docScrollW == 390). Only unrelated pre-login 401/400 console errors observed.
